criteria.name: Final ledger result
criteria.description: Returns landfall_window_confirmed, score 6/6, and an empty failed_tests list.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct label with an incomplete score or missing failed-test field; award 1 point for stating that most checks pass.

criteria.name: Wind and pressure anchors
criteria.description: Reports catalog wind near 249.998 km/h, minimum pressure near 966.9 hPa at 2022-09-28T19:00, and peak gust near 185.4 km/h at 2022-09-28T19:00.
criteria.partial_credit: Award about 1 point for each correct numeric anchor or timestamp, allowing the stated tolerance.

criteria.name: Gust-pressure timing
criteria.description: Computes the absolute lag between peak gust and minimum pressure as 0.0 hours and compares it with the 1-hour limit.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for recognizing close timing without calculating the exact lag.

criteria.name: Rainfall-window arithmetic
criteria.description: Computes event rainfall near 211.5 mm, wettest 24-hour rainfall near 149.9 mm, wettest 24-hour share near 0.709, and peak-rain lag near 3.0 hours.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correct rainfall anchor, allowing small rounding differences.

criteria.name: Threshold proof
criteria.description: Applies all six inequalities or timing windows and shows that each test passes.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct calculations with missing or loosely applied pass/fail checks.

criteria.name: Compact JSON output
criteria.description: Uses the requested JSON fields, UTC timestamps where included, and concise rounded numeric anchors.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a mostly readable structure that includes the label and main anchors but is not valid compact JSON.
